Hi Samira — thanks for the quick repro materials. I did a first pass on the error log you attached. A few things to validate from your side that commonly cause 5xx on rerank flows: 

1) Content-type / JSON shape: ensure requests to /v1/rerank use application/json and that candidate arrays are under the expected key (candidates). Malformed nested objects can trigger server-side parsing errors.
2) Payload size: if your batch contains large candidate payloads (long text + metadata), try reducing batch size to 1-2 and see if errors disappear.
3) API key scopes: make sure the API key used for that environment has rerank:write permissions. Keys without the proper scope sometimes trigger 403 or backend exceptions; we’ll check logs for a scope mismatch.
4) Timeouts: if the client-side timeout is too low we sometimes see intermediate 502s during upstream cold starts; try increasing to 30s while we triage.

Quick repro command (curl) you can try to validate shape:

curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_KEY>\" 
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" 
  -d '{"query":"sample query","candidates":[{"id":"1","text":"candidate text"}] }'

If you can paste one failed request body & the exact timestamp (including timezone) we’ll search the logs and get back with a root cause or hotfix ETA. I’ll try to reproduce with your Postman collection and our SDK emulator this afternoon.

Also including a link to our SDK auth docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/docs/sdk/authentication#api-keys

-Neha

Thanks Samira — very helpful. Reproduced locally with a similar payload and batch size 10; looks like we hit a memory pressure path in the reranker when candidate payloads exceed ~32KB total per request.

Immediate options:
- Workaround: reduce batch size to 5 or stream candidates in multiple smaller calls (we know 1 and 5 were stable).
- Short-term fix: we can deploy a hotfix to increase the memory headroom for rerank workers; I’m opening a ticket with infra now and will post an ETA to the support ticket.

Camila, can you prioritize a hotfix verification? I’ll add repro and logs to the ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/78921

Samira — can you confirm whether reducing to batch size 5 is acceptable for the POC? If not, we’ll prioritize the hotfix and propose a canary deployment window (ETA ~24-48 hours).

-Neha
